overview_description.description:
Jumbo Privacy offers a mobile application available on iOS and Android that helps users manage their online privacy and security.

At Jumbo, they believe that your data belongs to you. That’s why their app empowers users to take control of their privacy and security, right from their phones. Jumbo is an app that gives you back control of your data and privacy.

about_short_description.short_description: Jumbo Privacy is a B2C privacy and security app that protects users on iOS and Android.

product.name: Jumbo App
product.description: A mobile application available on iOS and Android that helps users protect their online privacy and security by giving control over privacy settings, notifying of data breaches, checking Wi-Fi security, and blocking trackers.

product.name: Identity Theft Insurance
product.description: Provides identity theft insurance coverage up to $1,000,000 in the US to help users restore their identity if stolen.

product.name: Do Not Call List
product.description: A feature that allows users to add their phone numbers to the FTC’s Do Not Call list to reduce telemarketing calls.

product.name: Blur My Home
product.description: A feature that enables users to blur their home on Google Street View to maintain privacy and security.

product.name: Dark Web Scan
product.description: A service that scans the dark web for users' personal information to alert them of potential data breaches.

product.name: Social Media Archiving
product.description: Allows users to archive old social media posts to reduce their digital footprint and manage their online presence.
